title: GA4 user property 'name' appears to hold people's first names
what: Raw GA4 export, 11–17 Nov: the app user property 'name' is set for 6,934 iOS and 2,496 Android users, with 807 and 436 distinct values; every value is letters only, average 4.5–4.7 characters. That pattern fits first names (inferred; the values were not read). Sending names to GA4 conflicts with the no-PII rule (PDPL). Other user properties (DeviceID, USER_ID, user_id, user_ref) are identifiers, not names.
